entries.symptom: Required CI interpretation could become unsafe or unavailable when check identity, legacy commit-status evidence, or policy access was incomplete.
entries.root_cause: The first resolver modeled check names but not every authority dimension needed for fail-closed promotion.
entries.fix: Require explicit mergeable check states, retain app identity, ingest Commit Status evidence, and classify inaccessible live policy as UNCERTAIN.
entries.verification: Exact-head preflight and fresh PR CI passed after regression coverage for unrecognized states, wrong-app checks, legacy statuses, and inaccessible policy.
entries.regression_protection: Dedicated decision, GitHub-evidence, and required-check resolver tests exercise each repaired failure mode.
entries.residual_risk: Required-workflow rules remain UNCERTAIN until mapped to concrete workflow evidence; this is an intentional fail-closed limitation.

entries.symptom: Pre-change risk predictor marked an unrelated Everward subsystem as HISTORICAL_SIGNALS_PRESENT.
entries.root_cause: Area-learning similarity included generic repository/path tokens such as src and simulation, so weak structural overlap was mistaken for meaningful domain overlap.
entries.fix: Filter generic path/repository tokens from risk matching and require either an explicit path match or at least one informative matched token before a lesson contributes to the risk profile.
entries.verification: Exact-head full preflight passed on commit 9675dab700fada6b6fa5c6a02f45b1261dbf7cc4 with 269 tests passing, including a regression test for unrelated same-repository paths.
entries.regression_protection: Pre-change risk matching must ignore generic structural tokens and preserve NO_RELEVANT_VERIFIED_HISTORY when no informative area match exists.
entries.residual_risk: New generic tokens introduced by future repository layouts may require extending the bounded generic-token set; explicit path matches remain authoritative evidence.

entries.symptom: Independent product projects could remain idle across scheduled runs while the orchestrator repeatedly reported the same lane blocker or Product Reality dependency.
entries.root_cause: Anti-stall policy existed, but repeated blocker fingerprints, last advancement time, and promotion-flow timestamps were not persisted as enforceable scheduler state.
entries.fix: Add a deterministic bottleneck watchdog that persists lane-level blocker fingerprints and advancement state, escalates the same eligible no-progress fingerprint after two runs to a P1 orchestration defect, and requires lane rotation.
entries.verification: Watchdog unit tests cover first-run rotation, second-run P1 escalation, blocker changes, advancement reset, explicit-timestamp flow duration, and fail-closed missing evidence.
entries.regression_protection: Every scheduled run should feed explicit lane evidence through the watchdog; a repeated identical eligible no-advancement fingerprint may not be passively reported for a third run.
entries.residual_risk: The watchdog can only enforce what the scheduler records; incomplete or false eligibility evidence must continue to fail closed and cannot be inferred.

entries.symptom: Required PR workflows concluded action_required before creating any jobs, so the PR could not reach GREEN and there was no failing test traceback to repair.
entries.root_cause: The blockage occurs before job execution in GitHub Actions; job listing returned zero jobs and a bounded failed-job rerun was rejected by GitHub with HTTP 403 because the workflow run cannot be retried.
entries.fix: Classify this fingerprint as a pre-job GitHub Actions/platform or approval gate, park only the dependent CI lane, and rotate to parallel-safe Rocksmith work instead of repeatedly searching for nonexistent job logs.
entries.verification: Live workflow-run evidence for PR #565 showed action_required across six workflows, the CI run exposed zero jobs before and after retry, and the retry request returned 403 cannot be retried.
entries.regression_protection: When action_required has zero jobs, do not classify it as a test failure; attempt workflow-run and job retrieval once, record the pre-job fingerprint, and continue independent product work.
entries.residual_risk: The connector evidence does not expose the underlying GitHub approval or policy reason, so the exact platform-side cause remains UNKNOWN until GitHub surfaces additional evidence or a human resolves the gate.
